shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -100; ls ../icons/package.json && grep '"version"' ../icons/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls layout controls controls/TextInput; grep -n "errorMessage\|validationState\|errorPlacement\|hasClear\|note\|label" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "imgUrl\|text\|size\|icon" Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "content\|description\|onUpdate\|size" Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -20

grep -n " id?\|name?\|errorMessage\|validationState\|filterable\|disablePortal" Select/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "imgUrl\|  text\|size?\|icon?\|theme?" Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head; grep -n "onUpdate\|onChange" Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|wrap" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "onUpdate" Switch/*.d.ts Checkbox/*.d.ts controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head
cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts | grep -n "?:" | head -20; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "onChange\|onUpdate\|checked" controls/types.d.ts types.d.ts | head
